message.name: estimate_distance
message.content: {"error": "distance not found in database."}

<|channel>thought
<channel|>抱歉，我無法直接透過城市名稱計算距離。為了幫您精確計算從舊金山到 Rivermist 的距離，請問您能提供這兩個地點的**郵遞區號 (Zip Code)** 嗎？
I have updated some more functions you can choose from. What about now?

I still need the zip codes for both San Francisco and Rivermist to calculate the distance accurately. 

If you don't have the zip codes handy, you can provide the **city names**, and I can try to look them up for you first. Once I have the zip codes, I'll be able to estimate the distance and help you plan your fuel stops!
在開始這段旅程之前，請為我的車輛加油，讓油量達到50加侖。
